response.sql: WITH award_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM player_award AS pa JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '')), shares AS (SELECT batting_hand, award_count, award_count * 1.0 / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share FROM award_counts) SELECT batting_hand, award_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS above_average FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) ORDER BY share DESC, batting_hand;
